changes: Load Documents runtime in the Home booking shell so linked attachments are available in production booking popups
Remove RC25.7.16 universal post-render action injector; each booking renderer owns exactly one shared action surface
Make Booking Authority persist editable deltas instead of complete booking snapshots
Protect corrected deploy-master financials and newly shipped useful links from stale booking snapshots
Background-sync Documents metadata on shell load and foreground resume
Clean the portable CI runner so active tests actually execute before the final result
Add single-writer booking-sync-runtime with startup, foreground, online and 30-second visible sync
Remove automatic Booking and Timeline publication triggers; Publish Latest Trip is now the deliberate release boundary
Add document ownerKey permissions and Studio-only contextual link management
Fix offline document tombstones and pending metadata so they retry on later sync
Align Documents polling contract with Expenses and Moments
Fix Booking Studio save failure caused by trip-runtime calling BOOKING_SYNC.enabled()/push() methods missing from booking-sync-runtime; make delete local-first with best-effort cross-device sync.
Replace Christchurch first-night Southwark booking with Novotel Christchurch Cathedral Square and update Day 1/Day 2 Timeline, including hotel breakfast and 11:00 AM check-out.
Expand Booking Authority editable projection to persist every Booking Studio field rendered in booking details, including parking, contact, activity pricing and rental-car operational fields.
Add a round-trip persistence CI contract covering Save → local reload → remote state replacement → reload for all newly exposed Booking Studio fields.

Simplify Booking Studio by consolidating parking, arrival/check-in instructions, booking-method notes and FX notes into Notes / important information while retaining structured Address, Phone and Website fields.
Resolve Guide Address, Phone and Website from the linked Booking place facts so Booking edits immediately surface in Guide without duplicate place data.

Audit Booking, Guide, Timeline and Trip ownership; remove redundant Booking Studio fields for guest occupancy, Booking time beside Related day, charge date, standalone cancellation and discount label; migrate cancellation into Notes and combine the cashback editor label as Discount / Cashback.
Add shared Place Authority for Address, Phone, Website, Hours, Description, Useful info and navigation overrides.
Add compact Guide Studio editor; Booking and Guide write the same shared Place facts.
Timeline Navigate resolves linked Place at render time instead of retaining a third place-address authority.
Make Documents real-browser gate deterministic by stubbing configured FX providers inside the test context only.

Make Guide display match Guide Studio ownership: render only shared Place facts, Description and Useful info; remove legacy Booking/stay/highlight snapshots from Guide body; expose Website action and meaningful Hours only outside Stay places.

Correct Saigon Kingdom Viet location/route wording from Frankton to 88 Beach Street in central Queenstown across Guide and Timeline, while preserving the Day 10 flow toward Frankton for refuel, rental return and airport.
Prevent Service Worker navigation from substituting index.html for a failed Day/Trip/other multi-page route; use the requested route cache or offline document only.
Stabilize Moments mobile keyboard/visualViewport handling by suppressing forced nav layout work while an editor field is focused.
Add optimistic updatedAt conflict protection for simultaneous edits of the same Moment across devices.
Restore deterministic foreground hierarchy: application modal 30000, User Selector 31000, Trip Studio 32000.
Add crash-specific regression contract to the mandatory CI gate and rebuild release checksums from the production manifest.
CF3: make Moment edit Save single-flight and editor-session scoped; re-read live Moments after async checks so late saves cannot erase sync-delivered data or another editor.
CF3: separate semantic contentUpdatedAt from photo/sync updatedAt so pending-photo retry can sync without creating a false edit conflict.
CF3: harden Service Worker navigation cache identity using route-specific data-trip-page-title plus HTML MIME validation, rejecting Home/captive-portal/wrong-MIME poisoning.
CF3: add mandatory behavioural regression tests for Moment Save merge semantics, photo retry revision semantics and Service Worker route identity.
CF4: restore Service Worker route identity for moments.html and itinerary.html so Moments and Days remain reachable under SW control.
CF4: make pending-photo flush patch the live Moments collection after upload instead of writing a pre-upload snapshot.
CF4: treat a newer remote tombstone updatedAt as an edit conflict so a stale editor cannot resurrect a remotely deleted Moment.
CF4: scope pending Moment Save locks to editor sessions so stale async completion cannot unlock a newer editor.
CF4: add production-executing regression tests for photo-flush live merge, remote-delete conflict and Service Worker navigation wiring, plus session-lock contract coverage.

CF4.1 tests-only: add comment-stripped production wiring gate for syncNow→flushPhotos, Save→hasRemoteNewer, SW navigationResponse→validated navigation, and session-scoped Save locking; production runtime files remain byte-identical to CF4.
FR2: make precached release JS/CSS cache-first so cross-page navigation cannot mix a coherent HTML document with transient 404/5xx/wrong-MIME runtime responses.
FR2: reject invalid critical JS/CSS network responses and return typed 503 only when neither the atomic release cache nor a valid network asset exists.
FR2: retain corrected Trip menu order without FR1 non-Home forced Home redirect; Trip and Days use their local shared navigation shell.
FR2: add behavioural critical-asset regression coverage for cached-network failure, healthy recovery, 404/500, HTML-as-JS and CSS.
